params.prompt: Using this group portrait as the exact identity reference for all four doctors, create a new environmental group photo: the same four people — identical faces, hair and builds, same relative heights — standing together relaxed and smiling in a bright modern dental office corridor with pale blue walls and warm natural window light, wearing the same professional attire. CRITICAL: each face must remain recognizably identical to the reference. Editorial healthcare brand photography, medium format, photorealistic.
